alert_summary: A high-confidence phishing attempt was detected involving a look-alike domain (zoomcall-invites.com) and evidence of scanning activity.

investigation_timeline.output_summary: regex: 8 candidates, 4 validated; LLM: 3 candidates, 3 validated

risk_assessment.rationale: The use of 'zoomcall-invites.com' strongly suggests a targeted phishing campaign designed to mimic legitimate Zoom services. This risk is further validated by the high confidence/severity rating and evidence of scanning activity, indicating an organized attempt to compromise credentials or deliver malicious content.

recommended_actions: Block the source IP at the network perimeter
Escalate to the incident response / Tier 2 team
Correlate this indicator against the wider environment beyond this alert's time window
recommended_actions_freeform_experimenta:
Perform a deep-dive analysis of the 'zoomcall-invites.com' domain to identify registration details (WHOIS) and potential hosting infrastructure.

Conduct a search across the mail gateway logs for any other internal recipients who may have received emails from this specific sender or IP address to determine the scope of the campaign.

If a URL was present in the original email, it should be isolated and detonated in a controlled sandbox environment to identify the final landing page and any credential-harvesting scripts.

Implement a proactive block on both the 'zoomcall-invites.com' domain and the source IP (40.107.92.115) at the corporate firewall and email security gateway.

Issue a targeted security awareness notification to the specific user (tommy.wong@victimcorp.com) regarding the blocked phishing attempt to educate them on identifying look-alike domains.
